sloka: सा हि शोकसमाविष्टा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा ।मैथिली विजयं श्रुत्वा तव हर्षमुपागमत् ।। ६.११७.३ ।।
transliteration: sā hi śokasamāviṣṭā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā ।maithilī vijayaṁ śrutvā tava harṣamupāgamat ।। 6.117.3 ।।

translations.english: "Mythili who is overcome with grief on hearing your victory, was filled with tears in her eyes and desired to see you."
